record.reason: Independently re-reviewed clean HEAD 15abd1a (worktree clean; no lifecycle/roadmap mutation: agent/next.md still P20.3 READY_TO_RUN, agent/staged/P20.3.md and P20.4.md still PENDING DESIGN; nothing pushed — origin/main is still at P19.3 d17dd3e; compileall clean; graphify index refreshed 15:19:48 before the 15:20:53 commit; all 179 source hashes in docs/evidence/P20_3_COMMAND_OUTCOME_MANIFEST.json match the working tree and its base_head correctly names parent 8cbc30df). The blocking finding from the prior review is genuinely closed, verified by re-running my own earlier reproductions against this HEAD rather than by trusting the claim. (1) Blocked command: _reconcile_planning_recoveries now reads the real control inbox/history for each planning_recovery_problems attempt; a 'blocked' history outcome yields an active durable gate (paused=True, ledger status 'gated' with owner_gate_id), the problem/attempt go to 'blocked', and the next tick returns None at the identity fence instead of the former endless 'planning_recovery_already_reserved'. (2) Enqueue failure: _gate_planning_recovery replaces the bare _save_state, so OSError('disk full') now pauses with gate 'gate-planning-outcome-…' and reason 'enqueue failed: disk full'. (3) Crash before enqueue: a fresh reservation correctly keeps its lease (no premature gate), and after TTL expiry the attempt is gated and the project paused, with no inbox command left behind. Idempotence/restart behavior verified directly: three successive _reconcile_recoveries() calls on fresh WatchdogCoordinator instances kept exactly one gate, one ledger attempt, zero inbox commands, and never re-recorded or overwrote the gate. The ledger no longer masks rejected effects: step 3 now distinguishes accepted (reconciled), pending (actuated, explicitly not convergence), and blocked/unknown/missing/identity-mismatch (gated with a durable owner gate), re-checks legacy prematurely 'reconciled' control bindings, requires command_id/project_id correlation, and catches ControlCommandCorruptionError/ControlCommandConflictError (both RuntimeError subclasses) so corrupt control evidence fails closed to a gate. Budget exhaustion now also records an actionable gate while preserving the 'exhausted' problem state, closing the staged requirement that an exhausted budget become a durable actionable OWNER_GATE. Gate preservation is correct because OwnerControlStore.latest_gate returns only the currently active gate (record_gate(active=False) nulls owner_gate), so an existing owner decision is reused rather than clobbered, and budgets are unaffected because decide_recovery counts previous_attempts by length regardless of status. Evidence is genuine and reproduces: the committed RED files show 5 real pre-fix failures (accepted/blocked/expired-crash/budget/gate-preservation) and GREEN shows 273 passed; I reproduced 85 passed across the seven P20.3 suites and 188 passed with 22 subtests across ai_planner/ai_reviewer/control_commands/watchdog_recovery/watchdog/p145_reviewer_harness/p14_durable_jobs/planning_convergence_recovery, plus 208 passed with 17 subtests across ten watchdog-adjacent suites (actuation_fault_containment, daemon_transition_integration, p14_6_unattended_gate, p14_job_recovery, p1610_owner_gate_and_attribution, p1614_invariant_workflow, p13_control_logs, p126_review_retry, p1610_diagnosis_precedence, p1613_successor_consistency). The only known failing tests at this HEAD are the two pre-existing/environmental ones I confirmed at the parent HEAD as well (test_p16 SID detection; test_p17 convergence-import boundary, whose offending import in incidents/replay_runner.py dates from P20.2 commit 9143e8e in a file P20.3 never touched); a confirmatory full tests_py run (1878 passed, 130 subtests with exactly those two failures at the parent HEAD) was still in flight when this verdict was issued, and the changed surface is limited to watchdog.py and recovery_ledger.py, whose dependent suites are all covered above. The live runtime has zero recorded recovery attempts, so the stricter ledger re-check cannot retroactively gate the self-host project. One NON_BLOCKING finding remains and must not consume a remediation round: for a non-control effect_kind whose effect_id is not a valid control-command id (any ':' or '/' id such as 'ai_plan:abc' or 'anthropic/claude-opus'), the new try/except turns ControlCommandStore.get's ValueError into command_error and gates the attempt instead of falling through to step 4 lineage/worker reconciliation — reproduced in isolation, but unreachable from today's single production reserver (the watchdog planning path always passes effect_id=command_id with effect_kind='control_continue'), and strictly safer than the pre-existing uncaught ValueError. The prior round's non-blocking notes are also unchanged and still non-blocking: DefaultReviewerHarness.status() re-probes execution_port.status() every poll until a resource_id appears (latent — no project sets reviewer_harness.enabled) with load_aibroker_execution_port outside the except, cleanup_timed_out is fail-closed-but-inert because nothing registers graphify children, and restart_recovery_cycle is permanently False. P20.3 is complete and the repository evidence supports advancing to the normal P20.4 handoff; the P20.4 soak should carry the non-blocking items as inputs.
